args.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT user_session, max(event_type='purchase') p FROM ecommerce.events GROUP BY 1) SELECT brand, round(sum(price),2) cart_value, count(DISTINCT e.user_session) sessions FROM ecommerce.events e JOIN s USING(user_session) WHERE e.event_type='cart' AND NOT s.p GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 8

WITH d AS (SELECT CAST(event_time AS DATE) day, sum(price) rev FROM ecommerce.events WHERE event_type='purchase' GROUP BY 1) SELECT day, round(rev,2) rev, round((rev-avg(rev) OVER())/stddev(rev) OVER(),2) z FROM d ORDER BY abs(z) DESC LIMIT 5

WITH s AS (SELECT user_session, bool_or(event_type='purchase') p FROM lakehouse.ecommerce.events GROUP BY 1) SELECT brand, round(sum(price),2) cart_value, count(DISTINCT e.user_session) sessions FROM lakehouse.ecommerce.events e JOIN s USING(user_session) WHERE e.event_type='cart' AND NOT s.p GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 8

WITH d AS (SELECT CAST(event_time AS DATE) AS dia, sum(price) AS rev FROM lakehouse.ecommerce.events WHERE event_type='purchase' GROUP BY 1) SELECT dia, round(rev,2) AS rev, round((rev-avg(rev) OVER())/stddev(rev) OVER(),2) AS z FROM d ORDER BY abs(z) DESC LIMIT 5
